title: Insulation Resistance and Electric Strength Requirements
text: The insulation resistance between live parts of the lamp cap and accessible parts of the lamp body shall be not less than 4 Megohms (MΩ) when tested with a DC voltage of 500 V applied for 1 minute. Following the insulation resistance test, the lamp shall withstand an AC dielectric strength test of 4000 V RMS for 1 minute without breakdown or flashover.

title: Marking Requirements for Self-Ballasted LED Lamps
text: Lamps shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the following mandatory information on the lamp body: (a) Mark of origin (manufacturer name or registered trade mark); (b) Rated supply voltage or voltage range in Volts; (c) Rated wattage in Watts; (d) Rated frequency in Hertz; (e) Standard Mark (ISI mark with CM/L number or CRS registration number R-XXXXXXXX). Markings must be legible after rubbing for 15 seconds with a cloth soaked in water and petroleum spirit.

title: Lamp Wattage and Operating Power Factor
text: The initial power consumed by the self-ballasted LED lamp shall not exceed 110 percent of the rated wattage. The power factor of lamps with rated wattage greater than 5W shall not be less than 0.90 for high power factor lamps or 0.50 for standard power factor lamps as declared by the manufacturer.

title: Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) and Harmonics Current Emission
text: The harmonic current of the self-ballasted LED lamp shall comply with limits specified in IS 14700 (Part 3/Sec 2). For lamps having active power up to 25W, total harmonic distortion (THD) shall not exceed 33 percent for 3rd harmonic or 10 percent for 5th harmonic currents.

title: Gold Fineness Grades and Permitted Tolerances
text: Gold artefacts and jewellery shall be hallmarked under six recognized fineness grades: 24K (995 or 999 parts per thousand), 23K (958), 22K (916), 20K (833), 18K (750), and 14K (585). Negative tolerance in fineness is not permitted. Marking of solder or joint metals must not alter the overall certified assay grade.

title: Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) Inscription
text: Every individual hallmarked jewellery piece must bear three distinct marks applied at an authorized Assaying and Hallmarking Centre: (1) BIS Logo; (2) Purity in Karat and Fineness (e.g., 22K916); (3) 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) laser marked on the piece. The HUID code is tied cryptographically in the BIS portal to the jeweller licence, assay test certificate, and dispatch date.
source_doc: BIS Official Publication IS 1417 : 2016 / Hallmarking Regulations 2021

title: Compressive Strength Requirements for OPC 43 Grade
text: For 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement, the average compressive strength of mortar cubes (area 50 cm²) prepared from a mix of 1 part cement and 3 parts standard Ennore sand shall satisfy: (a) 72 hours ± 1 hr: Not less than 23 MPa; (b) 168 hours ± 2 hrs: Not less than 33 MPa; (c) 672 hours ± 4 hrs (28 days): Not less than 43 MPa and not more than 58 MPa.

title: Mechanical Properties of High Strength Deformed Steel Bars (Fe 500D)
text: For Fe 500D grade deformed TMT bars, 0.2 percent proof stress or yield stress shall be a minimum of 500.0 N/mm² (MPa). The tensile strength shall be at least 1.10 times the actual 0.2 percent proof stress and not less than 565.0 N/mm². Total elongation at maximum force (Agt) shall be minimum 5 percent and elongation on gauge length shall be minimum 16.0 percent.
source_doc: BIS Official Publication IS 1786 : 2008 (TMT Steel Bars)

title: Leakage Current and Dielectric Strength for Electric Irons
text: At normal operating temperature reached during iron soleplate heating, the electric leakage current measured between live conductors and external metal soleplate shall not exceed 0.75 mA for Class I appliances. The appliance insulation shall subsequently withstand 1000 V AC applied across basic insulation without breakdown for 60 seconds.
